policy: NCIt IRIs are reviewed mappings from self-reported NHANES cancer-type codes. They are not registry-confirmed diagnoses, histology confirmations, staging, treatment, recurrence, or current disease-status assertions. The second oncologist review recommends preserving source-level site information and not inferring histology from prevalence.

graph_assertion_policy: Rows with graph_assertion_allowed=yes may be asserted as qualified NCIt mapping metadata on self-reported NHANES cancer-type codes. They must not be interpreted as confirmed histology, registry diagnosis, stage, treatment, recurrence, or current disease status.
